title: The Endless Cellar
author: Ada Pemberton
blurb: Petra Nystrom, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
